Introductory Mechanics
Subject: Physics
Course level: INTRO PHYSICS MECHANICS

Vectors and force components: resolve a force into signed x and y components.
Net Force: choose a positive direction and sum forces to obtain the resultant force.
Newton's Second Law: use F_net = m a to relate mass, acceleration, and net external force.

Worked evidence: a 4 kg cart with a 12 N net horizontal force accelerates at 3 m/s^2.
